articles.title: Asian Stocks to Gain as US Treasury Supports Bonds: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Asian bonds and stocks gained as US plans to buy back longer-dated Treasuries to curb borrowing costs buoyed sentiment. The dollar steadied after sliding to a three-month low.
